scenes.text: How to *get paid* training AI models through *Mercor*

scenes.title: Step 1: *the profile*
lines: Sign up at mercor.com, upload a resume, pick your fields: law, medicine, finance, coding, writing.
Credentials matter. Licensed and published people get the higher-paid projects.

scenes.title: Step 2: *the AI interview*
lines: About 20 minutes on video with Mercor's AI interviewer. Talk like you would to a hiring manager.
Have two real work examples ready to describe in detail.

scenes.title: Step 3: *the wait*
lines: Matching takes two to four weeks. Many people hear nothing at all.
Apply to listed projects too; don't wait for the match.

scenes.title: The *pay*
lines: Entry data tasks $12 to $25 an hour. Coding and RLHF work $25 to $53. Licensed doctors, lawyers and PhDs $75 to $200 plus.
Average quoted on 60 Minutes, Oct 2026: $95 an hour. Weekly payouts through Stripe.

scenes.title: The *fine print*
lines: You're a 1099 contractor: no benefits, you handle taxes.
Work comes in waves; a project can end without warning.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: The average is pulled up by specialists. Most newcomers start at the bottom tier.
Sources: Mercor on 60 Minutes, Oct 4, 2026; HeroHunt, TIME and Built In pay guides.
